commonContract.coordinateRule: Every x,y,w,h is approximate absolute logical px on504×894. Native editor local coords: childAbsXY minus parentAbsXY; if native percent required divide local by parentWH×100. Not actual source RectTransform/hitbox.
commonContract.sizeEvidence: r63 actual Back74×64/Recruit336×64/Header504×108. Proposed common CTA336×64 follows that; compact modal/source-specific exceptions noted in roles.

fontProposal.family: existing native Korean sans; source exact family unknown

commonContract.buttonHierarchy: Btn container > BG basic3/9frame + Img icon(optional) + Txt label. Parts independently editable; child image/text receives no own action and forwards input to parent. Buttons may tint pressed; never bake labels into image.
commonContract.rewardHierarchy: Group > BG basic9frame + Img icon + Txt unit(optional top) + Txt count(bottom-right). Same size tokens within same role; large celebratory cards92×92 versus compact72×72.
commonContract.frameRule: Use default basic 3/9frame. 3 for horizontal header/pill with preserved endcaps; 9 for panels/cards. No invented exact slice bounds. New art remains separate.
commonContract.artRule: references JPG are analysis-only. No full screenshot as UI art or crop-derived product assets. New character/world/banner/icon art; native text separately.
commonContract.inputRule: TS12 nickname native editable input. No fake text pretending to input.
commonContract.entryRule: Use existing visible entrances. Missing sample entrance => UI Studio list standalone and entry unverified. No temporary fake game buttons. Dismiss returns actual caller/backstack.
commonContract.stateRule: Use observed selected/gray variants; gray alone does not prove disabled. Video values are fixtures, not approved game balance. No account/save/real time/economy logic inferred.
commonContract.excludedNonGame: OS GooglePlay notification / Steam chat / cursor / pink pointer / editor tooltip/outline excluded.
commonContract.verification: This worker viewed assigned references and read JSON only; no browser, native assembly/save, generated art, real input, responsive or screenshot verification.
